title: WHAT YOU FEED IS WHAT RULES YOU
paragraphs: WHAT YOU FEED IS WHAT RULES YOU
“Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.” — Romans 8:5

Every night exposes what we’ve been feeding all day.
The flesh is loud. The Spirit is patient.
One drains you. The other rebuilds you.

You don’t drift into life.
You decide into it.

Pause before you sleep.
Ask honestly: What ruled me today?
